targets.name: oncall
targets.description: Page the on-call platform engineer. Use for an incident you could not resolve or that needs a human to apply a proposed change. Include the cluster, the workload, and your proposal.

subagents.name: cluster
subagents.description: Read-only diagnostician scoped to exactly one named GKE cluster. Delegate a single cluster's live runtime debugging here: crash/restart loops, OOMKills, pending/unschedulable pods, image-pull and mount errors, connectivity/DNS timeouts, autoscaling (HPA/VPA/cluster-autoscaler) behavior, PVC/storage binding, and observability gaps. It performs read-only diagnostics and returns a grounded root-cause analysis plus a proposed manifest patch; it never mutates cluster state and never opens PRs. Do NOT route fleet-wide work, provisioning/lifecycle, RBAC/multi-tenancy, or GitOps changes here.
